purpose: Pinned Uniswap v4 sources for Sacred's fixed-pool spot adapter (chain 5042002). Installed by scripts/install-v4-deps.sh; each fetch is verified against the commit SHA below.

dependencies.name: v4-core
dependencies.note: Core commit pinned by v4-periphery 3779387 (lib/v4-core). Its PoolManager compiles to the same runtime code as v4.0.0 (e50237c) and as the Arc PoolManager.
dependencies.license: BUSL-1.1 (PoolManager, see licenses/); MIT/GPL-2.0-or-later per file SPDX header

dependencies.name: v4-periphery
dependencies.note: No release tags upstream. Commit 'Add per hop slippage checks (#497)'. Its PositionManager, V4Quoter and StateView reproduce the Arc runtime code.

dependencies.name: permit2
dependencies.note: Submodule pin of v4-periphery 3779387. Interfaces/libraries only are imported.

dependencies.name: solmate
dependencies.note: Submodule pin of v4-core 59d3ecf (Owned, ERC6909/ERC721 bases). Tests and mixins omitted.

notVendored.name: openzeppelin-contracts
notVendored.reason: Only needed to compile v4-periphery PositionManager/PositionDescriptor, which Sacred deploys no copy of. Sacred contracts use @openzeppelin/contracts 5.6.1 from package.json.

notVendored.name: forge-std
notVendored.reason: Existing lib/forge-std 1.16.2 pin is preserved unchanged.

compiler.upstreamBuild: solc 0.8.26, via_ir, optimizer_runs 44444444 (PositionManager 30000), bytecode_hash none, evm cancun
compiler.caveat: v4-core PoolManager.sol has an exact 'pragma solidity 0.8.26'. It cannot be imported into a 0.8.28 compilation unit; use interfaces/libraries (pragma ^0.8.x) in contracts, and the live fork or a 0.8.26 profile for tests that need a PoolManager.
